title: CheckThat run record
description: One revision of a run, as stored in CheckThatDB.global.runs, in a /ct export results string, and in evidence/runs/<id>/r<revision>.json. Unknown keys are allowed so an older reader keeps working. A key an older run lacks is simply absent: read it as unknown, never as zero or false.

ct.description: The major version. It rises only for a change that breaks a reader; a reader of an older major leaves the run alone.

current.description: Position in order of the step the card showed. Browsing moves it without a new revision, so a tool must not use it to compare revisions.

history.description: Step ids in the order their results were recorded. Undo walks it backwards. A rerun removes the steps it reopens.

formatRev.description: The newest format revision that wrote this run. It rises with every additive change and never goes down on a run. Absent in a run saved before 0.15.0: read it as unknown.

writerVersion.description: The CheckThat version (TOC) that last changed the run. Absent when unknown.

targetVersion.description: The TOC version of the addon under test (the plan's addon) when the run started. Absent when the client could not say (formatRev 3 and later).

reopened.description: True on a pending step that Undo or a rerun reopened after it had a result. Cleared by the next result or when the step leaves the run. Absent means unknown (formatRev 1 or older), not false. Read it only on a pending step.

macroStale.description: How many times the CT macro ran while the card showed a different step than the macro was written for. Counted on the step the card showed. Absent means none, or a run from before formatRev 4.

unmet.description: Since formatRev 6. On an inapplicable step: the text of the requirement the character does not meet (a class or a profession). Absent otherwise.

outcomes.description: One per check of the step, in plan order (the position is the check's index).

ticks.description: Since formatRev 6. One entry per listed action of the step: the time the player ticked it, or false. Absent when the step lists no actions or nothing was ticked. Ticks never change the verdict.

at.description: Since formatRev 6. start: CheckThat judged this async step when the run started. Absent otherwise.

excerpt.description: Failed or unverified attempts only: the first 20 new lines of each log the step checks, each cut to 200 characters. Position i is hit position n=i of an attempt-scope check on the same source.

build.description: The client build when the attempt opened, as the run's build is written. Absent when the client could not say.

formatRev.description: The format revision this attempt was finished in. Absent in an attempt saved before 0.15.0.

diagnostic.description: A diagnostic check never gates the verdict.

kind.description: This key and the ones after it are kept only for a check that did not pass.

scope.description: attempt: the lines after the step opened. session: the whole retained log. Absent on a check with since.

since.description: Since formatRev 5. run: the check read the lines after the run started (a plan's scope: run). Absent otherwise.

source.description: The log source the check read.

rule.description: What the check required, in words (at most 120 characters). It holds the plan's literals, which can be a log line: show it only where log text may be shown.

matched.description: Lines (or facts, or sequence items in a row) that matched. Absent when the window was lost.

unchecked.description: Lines (or facts) the plan's pattern could not be run on because they took too long to match. They are neither matches nor misses. Absent when there were none.

window.description: How many lines the check looked at.

stoppedAt.description: A sequence: the first item that was not found.

observed.description: A state check: the value it read, cut to 80 characters.

trimmed.description: The hit text was dropped to keep the run under its size budget.

shape.description: The rule with the plan's literals left out (contains "…"). Safe to show where log text is not.

n.description: 1-based position inside the lines the check looked at.

item.description: A sequence: which item this line matched.

line.description: The log line, cut to 200 characters.

value.description: A fact: the parsed value, cut to 80 characters.
